statement: If P_1 = c {S^(1)(P_b),-} on a family (engine B: c = -(1/3 + f_P) unit on the scalar bilinears, -f_P on letters), the order-hbar realisation forces K_1 = gamma (1/4) div v - c {S^(1)(K_b),-} (kap = gam, cK = -cP) and S_1(eta) = Q_1(rho(x)eta) - c {S^(1)(eta),-} (+ U_eta), with M_1 and the Delta rescaling zero; the outer direction t cancels in these differences.  Design thm:o-KD and eq:o-SQ hold only for c = 0.
